column6: the Reina-Valera 1909 prints the Levites' town of Naphtali in 1CH 6:76 as Ammón (H2540), the Spanish name of the land of Ammon too, and hammon-2 had no Spanish line, so the map list read the two alike; the English line is another name for Hammath (Hamat Tiberias), and Hammath is Hamath in the Spanish names
